profile.description: Neighborhood bistro with pickup and delivery. Search the menu, place orders and check on them.

scope_labels.read: See the menu and your orders

phrases: what pasta does Demo Bistro have
what is the status of order A1042
order a margherita pizza from Demo Bistro

search_menu.title: Search the menu
example_phrases: what's on the menu at Demo Bistro
what pasta does Demo Bistro have
search_menu.speakable_response: I found {count:results} dishes at Demo Bistro, including {list:results.name}.
search_menu.empty_response: I couldn't find any dishes matching that.

get_order_status.title: Check an order
example_phrases: what is the status of order A1042
where is my Demo Bistro order
get_order_status.speakable_response: Order {order_id} is {status}. It should be with you in about {eta_minutes} minutes.

error_responses.404: I couldn't find that order on your Demo Bistro account.

place_order.title: Place an order
example_phrases: order a margherita pizza from Demo Bistro
get me two tiramisu from Demo Bistro
place_order.confirmation_prompt: Should I order {quantity} × {item} from Demo Bistro?

error_responses.422: Demo Bistro didn't accept that order.
